title: Stop Playing It Safe: How to Break Free From Fear and Live Authentically
fullTitle: Soul Snack #84: Stop Playing It Safe: How to Break Free From Fear and Live Authentically

promo.text: Are you making choices in love or fear? Take this self-assessment today to find out

description: In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav and Linda Francis explore the concept of freestyling as a powerful metaphor for living authentically. Drawing from the world of sports – skiing, snowboarding, and gymnastics – Gary illuminates how the greatest athletes broke free from rigid conventions to create entirely new categories of movement. That same liberation, he teaches, is available to every person willing to move beyond the narrow expectations set by the frightened parts of their personality.

Gary explains that the frightened parts of the personality are what define the parameters – the narrow band of what feels “acceptable” in life. Whether in writing, relationships, or personal ambition, those fear-based limitations keep people performing the same routines. But when a person chooses to act from a loving part of their personality instead, they step into a domain that is entirely new, created by you, by choosing love.
Creating authentic power is the ultimate freestyle.

It is the practice of not being controlled by fear in the pursuit of external power and instead following the call of the heart and soul – even when that direction is subtle, uncertain, or not yet fully understood.

Take a moment to reflect on the areas of your life where the frightened parts of your personality have been setting the parameters. Where have you been staying inside the narrow band of what feels “acceptable” – in your relationships, your work, your creativity, or your goals? Ask yourself: What would I do if I were freestyling? What direction is your heart calling you toward that you have been hesitant to follow? Pause with that question today, and notice what arises.
